name: Eleanor Reed
source:
A wistful and bemused sweetheart, whose head is full of dreams and strangely philosophical reveries. She unabashedly loves pretty things, and is perfectly at ease with her mind and body, even if others find them distracting.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sadpandastudios/hush-hush-only-your-love-can-save-them/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
